name: Világokon át – Barangolás a metafizika birodalmában
original_name: Világokon át – Barangolás a metafizika birodalmában
overview: The fundamental question raised by this program, which deals with metaphysical topics, is: Is there some kind of spiritual force or organizing principle behind our experiences, or is it blind chance that has thrown us into this state we call life?
